answer_1.quote: Developing autonomous agents that can complete complex tasks such as web navigation has been a significant challenge for the AI community.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs are web navigation trajectories, consisting of sequences of actions (e.g., click, type, scroll) and thoughts produced by the agent during interaction with real-world websites.

answer_2.quote: Following WebVoyager, we adopt Task Success Rate automatically evaluated by GPT-4o as the primary metric.

answer_3.quote: We follow and leverage GPT-4o to automatically evaluate the correctness of the trajectories produced by OpenWebVoyager.
